tldr: Black Moon Lilith transiting the 6th house: autonomy and the disowned self activate through work, routine, health, service, and daily maintenance.
body: Black Moon Lilith moving through the 6th house can activate the disowned, uncompromising self through work, routine, health, service, and daily maintenance. For roughly nine months, this transit may expose where shame, control, compliance, or refusal has gathered around these topics. You refuse to be a compliant worker or to ignore your body; raw instinct around labor and health. Resists being managed and is drawn to unconventional or independent work; clashes with bosses are common. Health here can mirror deeper emotional pressure, so treat the whole person, not just symptoms.
business: The disowned self activates through work, routine, health, service, and daily maintenance. Sets fierce boundaries at work and actually listens to the body.
shadow: Defiant burnout, or repression that surfaces as illness.
advice: Reclaim autonomy in the 6th house without letting reaction make the decision for you. Work with work, routine, health, service, and daily maintenance directly and consciously.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Black Moon Lilith house placement material.
